lanes.summary: The read-only review of PMAT-3477-gdn-gpu is complete. The GPU PTX implementations, F2 probe guarding, and GGUF refusal logic correctly reproduce the Qwen3.5 architecture and pass all checks (including the 256-wide KV attention loop quirk reproduction). However, the PR fails checklist item (3): the `forward_single` per-token loop contains an explicit `ex.sync_stream()?` at the end of every attention layer, and after the layer loop, it synchronizes again, downloads the intermediate `hidden` state to the host, and passes it to `hidden_to_logits` (which immediately re-uploads it to the GPU). This is a severe violation of the 'no host<->device sync inside the per-token loop beyond logits download' constraint.

findings.claim: State reset between F2 probe and generation is correct.
GPU `attention_layer_inner` introduces an unconditional host<->device sync inside the layer, stalling the GPU pipeline every 6th layer.
findings.fix: Remove `ex.sync_stream()?` from `attention_layer_inner`; `state.kv_len = state.kv_len.max(position + 1)` on the host does not require a device sync.

findings.claim: GPU `forward_single` per-token loop syncs and downloads the hidden state to the CPU before the LM head, violating the 'no sync beyond logits download' rule.
findings.fix: Keep `dev` resident on the GPU and execute the final RMSNorm and LM head on the device buffer directly, instead of downloading it and passing it to `hidden_to_logits` (which just re-uploads it).

findings.claim: Refusal sites and quant gates correctly identify the Gated DeltaNet architecture without masking dense models.
Float GEMV is properly pinned in Qwen35CudaModel::new to prevent DP4A int8 activation quantization errors from compounding through the recurrence.

lanes.summary: Pre-merge review of branch PMAT-3477-gdn-gpu (PR: Qwen3.5 Gated-DeltaNet hybrid on CUDA, GitHub #3090, aprender 0.68.2 EPIC #3477) against origin/main. Verdict: PASS-WITH-CHANGES. The PTX kernels, delta-rule recurrence, partial NEOX RoPE, GQA decode attention, executor wrappers, F2 runtime guard, and refusal sites are mathematically correct and adhere to CPU reference specifications. However, per-layer stream synchronizations and an extraneous host DtoH/HtoD roundtrip in forward_single violate the zero-sync requirement and must be resolved before merge.

findings.claim: ex.sync_stream()?; in attention_layer_inner causes redundant host-device stream synchronization on every attention layer in the per-token loop.
findings.fix: Remove `ex.sync_stream()?;` from line 1041. Layers in the per-token loop should execute asynchronously on the CUDA stream without synchronizing until logits are downloaded.

findings.claim: ex.sync_stream() in deltanet_layer_inner causes redundant host-device stream synchronization on every DeltaNet layer in the per-token loop.
findings.fix: Remove `ex.sync_stream()` from line 1318 and return `Ok(())`. Streams must remain unsynchronized across layer boundaries.

findings.claim: forward_single synchronizes the stream, copies the hidden buffer to host, and passes it to hidden_to_logits which immediately copies it back to device via pad_and_upload_input.
findings.fix: In forward_single (lines 1370-1388), avoid copying `hidden` to host and back to device. Apply output RMSNorm and LM head GEMV directly on the device buffer `dev` on GPU and synchronize only at final logits download.

findings.claim: qwen35_cuda_the_parity_floor_is_the_cpu_references_own_activation_quantization explicitly calls gpu.pin_reference_gemv(), which masks whether Qwen35CudaModel::with_max_seq_len properly defaults to pinned float GEMV.
findings.fix: Remove line 1172 (`gpu.pin_reference_gemv();`) so the test exercises the constructor's default float GEMV configuration rather than manually re-pinning it.

lanes.summary: Comprehensive pre-merge review of branch PMAT-3477-gdn-gpu (PR: Qwen3.5 Gated-DeltaNet hybrid on CUDA, GitHub #3090, aprender 0.68.2 EPIC #3477) against origin/main. All 8 evaluation criteria (kernel correctness vs CPU reference, executor wrappers with graph recording, Qwen35CudaModel state and KV cache sizing, F2 hybrid guard validation, refusal site truthfulness and quant whitelisting, pinned float GEMV verification and DP4A falsification, test honesty and mutant coverage, and scope containment) have been rigorously verified and found fully compliant. Verdict: PASS.

findings.claim: Causal conv1d kernel correctly implements window shift (state[c][0..K-2] = state[c][1..K-1], state[c][K-2] = input[c]), pre-shift load order, and output SiLU activation exactly matching CPU reference.

Delta-rule recurrence kernel correctly maps state memory row j to S column j (s_h[j*D+i] = S[i][j]), assigns row j exclusively to thread j, computes decay, delta, update, and output projections in ascending i order with scale D^-0.5 matching CPU delta_rule_recurrence.

Gated RMSNorm kernel correctly normalizes the input only (gate is not normalized), computes rms_scale = 1/sqrt(mean(input^2) + eps), multiplies shared per-head weight, and applies silu(gate) matching CPU gated_rmsnorm.
Per-head L2 norm kernel correctly places epsilon on the sum of squares (sum(x_h^2) + eps) per head without dividing by head dimension, matching CPU l2_norm_per_head.
GDN gates kernel correctly computes dt[h] = softplus(alpha[h] + dt_bias[h]) * a[h] with x > 20 branching and beta[h] = sigmoid(beta_raw[h]) matching CPU reference.

Single-query decode attention kernel correctly supports head_dim up to 256, implements online max-subtracted softmax with multi-pass running sum/max rescaling, avoiding the head_dim <= 128 truncation defect of kernels/attention.

Partial NEOX RoPE rotates only dimensions 0..n_rot across pairs (j, j + n_rot/2) using host-computed theta_scale = freq_base^(-2/n_rot) and Cody-Waite range reduction before hardware sine/cosine approximation.
Split interleaved kernel performs pure data movement separating interleaved [q | gate] attention projections into contiguous q and gate buffers matching CPU copy_from_slice.

All executor wrappers in gdn_ops.rs perform graph_recording RecordedKernel pushes with arg_data matching launch parameters in order, and use unique cache keys parameterized by dimensions and constants.

Qwen35CudaModel dynamically sizes conv, recurrent, and KV cache states from config, matches CPU 256-wide head dimension in attention loop and KV cache, and resets device state cleanly between F2 validation and generation.

F2 hybrid runtime guard f2_validate_qwen35 uses CPU hybrid model (Qwen35Model::forward_single_qwen35) as reference, runs serial probe on throwaway states, maintains standard floors (0.95/0.98/0.90), and prints failure notices before fallback to CPU generation.

Refusal sites (unsupported_architecture_reason, dense_loader_refusal, hybrid_ssm_verdict, hybrid_gpu_quant_refusal) accurately admit qwen35 on GPU under cuda feature while refusing unhandled SSM architectures and dense loader lookups with truthful messages.
HYBRID_GPU_PROJECTIONS quant whitelist in dtype.rs strictly validates attn_qkv, ssm_alpha, ssm_beta, attn_gate, ssm_out, attention projections, and FFN projections against verified GPU GEMV kernels.
Qwen35CudaModel pins float MWV GEMV kernels (q4k=Mwv, q6k=Mwv) across all layer and lm_head GEMV dispatches, verified by dp4a_gemv_is_catastrophic_through_the_recurrence falsifier test.
